columns.name: market_code
columns.description: ISO-like market code used by this project (KR, JP, ID, VN, TH, CN, HK).

columns.name: market_name
columns.description: Display name. Korea is the Republic of Korea; Hong Kong is separate from mainland China.

columns.name: channel
columns.description: streaming_dsp, short_video, or social_influencer.

columns.name: channel_label
columns.description: Human-readable channel name.

columns.name: population
columns.description: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, total population, latest positive year in the pulled history.

columns.name: population_year
columns.description: Year of the population value.

columns.name: gdp_per_capita_usd
columns.description: World Bank NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, GDP per capita, current US dollars.

columns.name: gdp_per_capita_year
columns.description: Year of GDP per capita.

columns.name: gdp_per_capita_ppp_usd
columns.description: World Bank NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD, GDP per capita, PPP, current international dollars.

columns.name: gdp_per_capita_ppp_year
columns.description: Year of PPP GDP per capita.

columns.name: gdp_current_usd
columns.description: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, GDP, current US dollars.

columns.name: gdp_current_usd_year
columns.description: Year of total GDP.

columns.name: internet_pct
columns.description: World Bank IT.NET.USER.ZS, individuals using the Internet, percent of population.

columns.name: internet_pct_year
columns.description: Year of the internet-user percentage.

columns.name: internet_users
columns.description: population * internet_pct / 100 on the latest year where both series exist. Not a platform MAU.

columns.name: internet_users_year
columns.description: Year used for internet_users. May differ from population_year when the series do not share a latest year.

columns.name: internet_user_cagr
columns.description: CAGR of internet_users from the earliest to latest overlapping year, null if the span is under 3 years.

columns.name: internet_user_cagr_start_year
columns.description: Start year of internet_user_cagr.

columns.name: internet_user_cagr_end_year
columns.description: End year of internet_user_cagr.

columns.name: mobile_per_100
columns.description: World Bank IT.CEL.SETS.P2, mobile cellular subscriptions per 100 people.

columns.name: mobile_per_100_year
columns.description: Year of mobile subscriptions.

columns.name: broadband_per_100
columns.description: World Bank IT.NET.BBND.P2, fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people.

columns.name: broadband_per_100_year
columns.description: Year of fixed broadband.

columns.name: urban_pct
columns.description: World Bank SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS, urban population, percent of total.

columns.name: urban_pct_year
columns.description: Year of the urban share.

columns.name: share_age_0_14
columns.description: World Bank SP.POP.0014.TO.ZS, population ages 0-14, percent of total. Not ages 15-24.

columns.name: share_age_0_14_year
columns.description: Year of the 0-14 share.

columns.name: share_age_15_64
columns.description: World Bank SP.POP.1564.TO.ZS, population ages 15-64, percent of total.

columns.name: share_age_15_64_year
columns.description: Year of the working-age share.

columns.name: inflation_pct
columns.description: World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, consumer price inflation, annual percent. Can be negative.

columns.name: inflation_pct_year
columns.description: Year of inflation.

columns.name: fx_lcu_per_usd
columns.description: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF, official exchange rate, local currency units per US dollar, period average.

columns.name: fx_lcu_per_usd_year
columns.description: Year of the World Bank exchange rate.

columns.name: fx_frankfurter_lcu_per_usd
columns.description: Frankfurter (ECB) latest rate, local currency per USD. Null for VND: Frankfurter has no dong series.

columns.name: fx_frankfurter_date
columns.description: Frankfurter observation date. Same date for every market in a pull.

columns.name: secure_servers_per_million
columns.description: World Bank IT.NET.SECR.P6, secure internet servers per million people. Hong Kong is an extreme data-center outlier.

columns.name: secure_servers_per_million_year
columns.description: Year of the secure-server density.

columns.name: apple_chart_tracks
columns.description: How many tracks the Apple most-played songs feed returned. Usually echoes the requested length.

columns.name: apple_unique_artists
columns.description: Unique artistName values on that chart snapshot.

columns.name: apple_artist_diversity
columns.description: Unique artists divided by track count. Null if the storefront request failed.

columns.name: apple_genre_hhi
columns.description: Hirschman-Herfindahl index of primary chart genres. Generic Music genres are skipped when a more specific genre exists.

columns.name: apple_share_new_90d
columns.description: Share of chart tracks whose releaseDate is within 90 days before the feed updated timestamp.

columns.name: apple_chart_as_of
columns.description: Date parsed from the Apple feed updated field.

columns.name: pageview_window_start
columns.description: First month of the prior-12 pageview window, YYYY-MM.

columns.name: pageview_window_end
columns.description: Last complete month requested from the Wikimedia pageviews API, YYYY-MM.

columns.name: channel_pageviews_12m
columns.description: Sum of monthly user pageviews, last 12 complete months, for this channel's articles on the market's language Wikipedia. Null if fewer than 8 months were returned.

columns.name: channel_pageviews_prior_12m
columns.description: Same sum for the previous 12 months.

columns.name: channel_pageview_growth
columns.description: last_12 / prior_12 - 1. Null when prior views are under 50, so a tiny base cannot look like a boom.

columns.name: channel_attention_share
columns.description: This channel's last-12 pageviews divided by the three modeled channels. Null for every channel if any channel total is missing.

columns.name: channel_platforms_resolved
columns.description: How many pinned platform articles had a sitelink on this market's Wikipedia.

columns.name: channel_platforms_with_views
columns.description: How many of those articles had a usable last-12 pageview sum.

columns.name: streaming_pageview_growth
columns.description: Streaming-channel pageview growth, repeated on every channel row for the market. Audit column, not a model input.

columns.name: short_video_pageview_growth
columns.description: Short-video pageview growth, repeated on every channel row. Audit column, not a model input.

columns.name: social_pageview_growth
columns.description: Social/influencer pageview growth, repeated on every channel row. Not a count of brand deals.

columns.name: streaming_platform_hhi
columns.description: HHI of last-12 pageviews across streaming articles in the market. 1 means one article has all the views.

columns.name: streaming_platform_diversity
columns.description: 1 - streaming_platform_hhi. Ingredient of the indie score, not re-stretched by min-max.

columns.name: indie_accessibility_score
columns.description: Relative 0-1 score. See src/features/indie.py. Not a model input.

columns.name: opportunity_score
columns.description: Market-level ingredient of the proxy label. See src/features/proxy_target.py. Not a model input.

columns.name: proxy_return_per_dollar
columns.description: Synthetic label: opportunity times (0.35 + 0.65 * channel attention share). Not observed revenue per dollar.

columns.name: streaming_mau_observed
columns.description: Platform MAU was not in any retrieved source. Left null on purpose.

columns.name: streaming_mau_growth_observed
columns.description: No MAU history was retrieved. internet_user_cagr and streaming_pageview_growth are the proxies that do exist.

columns.name: streaming_subscribers_observed
columns.description: No territory subscriber series was retrieved. IFPI's global paid-account sentence is not copied onto markets.

columns.name: sync_rate_film_usd
columns.description: No public film sync rate card was retrieved.

columns.name: sync_rate_tv_usd
columns.description: No public TV sync rate card was retrieved.

columns.name: sync_rate_advertising_usd
columns.description: No public advertising sync rate card was retrieved.

columns.name: sync_rate_game_usd
columns.description: No public game sync rate card was retrieved.

columns.name: brand_deal_count_observed
columns.description: No public count of brand or influencer deals was retrieved.

columns.name: brand_deal_avg_usd_observed
columns.description: No public influencer rate card was retrieved.

columns.name: ad_cpm_usd_observed
columns.description: No public CPM by platform and territory was retrieved. Not filled with a guess.

columns.name: ad_cpc_usd_observed
columns.description: No public CPC by platform and territory was retrieved.

columns.name: channel_is_streaming_dsp
columns.description: 1 if this row is the streaming DSP channel.

columns.name: channel_is_short_video
columns.description: 1 if this row is the short-video channel.

columns.name: channel_is_social_influencer
columns.description: 1 if this row is the social/influencer channel.

columns.name: feature_completeness
columns.description: Share of COMPLETENESS_FIELDS that are non-null on this row.
